lead: Exploring the intersection of technology and health, from women's health startups seeking funding abroad to innovative AI applications in healthcare.

stories.title: Women’s health founders are heading overseas because local investors don’t prioritise them
stories.summary: In Australia, women's health startups are struggling to secure funding, leading many founders to seek investment opportunities overseas. This trend highlights a significant gap in local investor interest, which is causing a talent drain from the country. The lack of prioritization for women's health initiatives is raising concerns about the future of innovation in this critical sector.

stories.title: 10 Apple Health Hacks Every iPhone User Should Know
stories.summary: Apple Health offers a plethora of features that can enhance your health tracking without the need for an Apple Watch. This article outlines ten essential hacks that can help users maximize their health insights using just their iPhones. From tracking workouts to monitoring sleep patterns, these tips are designed to empower users to take charge of their health.

stories.title: Oura Ring 5 review: a stunning generational leap for smart rings
stories.summary: The Oura Ring 5 represents a significant advancement in health-tracking wearables, boasting a slimmer design and improved functionality. This new model is designed to be so comfortable that users can forget they're wearing it. However, it comes with a subscription model that may deter some potential buyers, raising questions about the accessibility of advanced health technology.

stories.title: How to check your PC's hard-drive health
stories.summary: While primarily a tech article, understanding your PC's hard-drive health can indirectly impact your overall digital wellness. This guide provides a step-by-step approach to checking hard-drive health on Windows systems, emphasizing the importance of maintaining your technology to ensure it supports your health-related applications effectively.

stories.title: ADHA sticks with Accenture for My Health Record support
stories.summary: The Australian Digital Health Agency (ADHA) has decided to continue its partnership with Accenture for support on the My Health Record system. This decision reflects ongoing efforts to enhance digital health records and improve patient care through better data management and technology integration.

stories.title: The rise of the AI operating executive
stories.summary: As AI technology evolves, the role of executives who can effectively integrate AI into business operations is becoming increasingly crucial. This article discusses how leaders are redefining their roles to harness AI's potential, which could significantly impact sectors like healthcare by improving operational efficiency and patient outcomes.

stories.title: AI agents need to learn when enough is enough
stories.summary: As AI agents become more autonomous, it's essential for them to recognize their limits, especially in healthcare settings where decisions can have serious implications. This article explores the need for AI systems to be designed with restraint, ensuring they act judiciously and do not overstep their authority in critical situations.

stories.title: ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok all went down at once; enterprises need a backup plan
stories.summary: Recent outages of major AI platforms highlight the vulnerabilities in relying on AI for operational tasks, including those in healthcare. This incident serves as a wake-up call for organizations to develop robust backup plans and maintain human oversight to ensure continuity in critical health services.
